feature: Every label in the video chrome reads whole
summary: At the default window size no button, value or name in the video editor is cut short any more: the Captions button reads Rewrite beside its count, Background names its colour, Easing reads Ease In and Out, and clip and Library names read whole. A walk step now reads every word on the window and fails on any cut one.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walks: captions-panel-keeps-its-margins-walk, timeline-bar-labels-only-walk, library-import-walk, an-editing-session-walk.

try.do: Open a screen recording with somebody talking and wait for its captions to write themselves.
In Captions, pick the Lower third style, then click the Captions row in Layers and look at Background.
Drag the panel's edge to its narrowest and look at the Generate row.
Key a title's Position twice and click one of its keys; read Easing at the right of the timeline bar.
Cut a stretch out of a recording and click the jump cut; read Spare before in Edit point.
Import Tutorial Sample.mp4 into the Library and read its tile.
Drag Sample Music from the Library to the timeline and read the clip line at the top of Properties.

evaluate: Does Rewrite say what the button does once captions are there, or would you rather it kept the mock's Auto captions?
Is the caption count beside the button worth keeping, given the Cue row under it already says 3 of 10?
Does Darker read as the right name for the Lower third plate beside Dark and Black?
Is a long clip name on its own line above the times better than one line with the name cut short?
Is a Library name set slightly smaller to fit better than one cut at its end?
rough: The mock's Generate button says Auto captions and nothing else. The app says Rewrite once captions exist, with the count beside it, because the task asked for the count; Auto captions and the count do not fit together at the default width.
The mock draws the clip line as one line. A name too long to sit beside the times now goes above them rather than being cut.
In the narrowest dock some things still give way on purpose: the language reads English (e..., and the Lower third and Save style tiles are cut. Rewrite and Darker stay whole there.
The word check cannot tell a value cut all the way down to ... from a three dot menu button, so a value that loses every letter is still found by eye (Spare before was found that way and fixed).
The word check has not been run on a locked screen yet, so it is not in any tutorial walk.
